info.title: ZenPay Merchant APIs
info.description: REST API for ZenPay merchants. Supports: Payments (one-off and recurring), Preauths (capture, void), Refunds, CreditRequests, BatchPayments, Customers (profile, account, status, payment options), CardProxies (card tokenization), Proxies (bank account tokenization), RequestPays (request-to-pay batches), Sessions (payment plugin), and Diagnostics (health check).

tags.name: BatchPayments
tags.description: A batch payment is a collection of payment entries submitted together for processing. Each entry settles asynchronously against a registered customer.

tags.name: CardProxies
tags.description: A card proxy is a secure tokenized reference to a credit or debit card. Card proxies allow PCI-compliant payment processing without handling raw card numbers.

tags.name: CreditRequests
tags.description: A credit request is a disbursement of funds to a customer bank account. Credits are submitted with a customer reference, amount, and destination account proxy.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: A customer represents a payer enrolled with a merchant. Each customer holds a profile, payment account details, payment options, and subscription status.

tags.name: Diagnostics
tags.description: API health and connectivity endpoints for verifying the service is operational.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: A payment is a one-off charge against a customer's card or bank account. Payments support card proxies, customer references, refunds, and 3D Secure authentication.

tags.name: Preauths
tags.description: A preauthorization places a hold on a customer's card for a specified amount. Preauthorizations can later be captured (converted to a payment) or voided (released).

tags.name: Proxies
tags.description: A proxy is a reference to a stored payment account (card, bank account, PayID, or PayTo). Proxies can be queried for details and applicable transaction pricing.

tags.name: RequestPays
tags.description: A request-to-pay sends a payment request to a customer via email or SMS. Customers receive a link to complete payment through the hosted payment page.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: A session is a secure, time-limited token used to initialize the hosted payment plugin. Sessions configure payment methods, amounts, customization, and callback URLs.

status.description: Below are the expected output values: 1) File Uploaded: Batch file is uploaded and pending file processing 2) Pending: Payment is not processed yet 3) Validation in Progress: Batch validation is in progress 4) On Hold - Potential Duplicate: Batch is on hold awaiting manual activation 5) Ready for Payment Processing: Batch duplicate validation is completed and now it is ready for Payment processing 6) On Hold Approved 7) Payment Processing in Progress: Batch payment processing in progress 8) Completed: Batch payment processing completed 9) Cancelled: Batch payment is cancelled 10) BatchPay Not Allowed: Error in processing - Merchant status doesn't allow to process batch payment 11) Merchant Not Found: Error in file/batch processing merchant code in file not found in database 12) Technical Error: Any technical error like batch entry has been added twice
status.title: Status

entryStatus.description: Below are the expected output values: 1) BatchPay Entry Pending: This Entry is waiting to be processed. 2) BatchPay Entry Processed: Payment for this Entry has been successfully processed. 3) Customer not found: This Customer is not found in system. Create the Customer using POST - /v2/customers API. 4) Duplicate entry: There is a duplicate entry in the batch. Remove duplicate entry. 5) Multiple customers found: The System has detected that there is Multiple Customers that have the same Reference setup. Check Customers and update reference. 6) Customer status is not open: Corresponding customer for batchpay entry is not in open state. Update Customer Status to Open. 7) Payment end date has expired: Payment End Date for BatchPay Entry has expired. Update Date to a future date. 8) Payment option is not BatchPay: Customer's Payment Option needs to be BatchPay in order to be processed. Update Customer Payment Option to BatchPay. 9) Customer status does not allow payment processing: Customer Status is invalid. Customer Status must be Open to process payments. Check Status of Customer. 10) Invalid payment amount: Payment amount is not valid. Check amount and resubmit. 11) Error during payment processing: There was an error while processing payment. Please contact Zenith Payments. 12) Technical Error: This Entry has encountered an unhandled error. Please contact Zenith Payments. 13) Cancelled: Batch is cancelled. 14) DuplicatePaymentUniqueId: Duplicate payment unique id.
entryStatus.title: Entry Status

paymentStatus.description: Below are the expected output values: 1) Pending: This Payment is waiting to be processed. 2) Error: This Payment has encountered an Error. 3) Submitted: This Payment was successfully submitted. 4) Successful: This Payment was successful. 5) Successful (Recalled): This Payment was Recalled. The System has detected that this Entry potentially has been submitted in another Batch. 6) Successful (Refunded): This Payment was Refunded. 7) Successful (Refunded) (Recalled): This Payment was Refunded and Recalled. 8) Failed: This Payment has Failed. 9) Cancelled: This Payment was Cancelled. 10) Suppressed: This Payment was Suppressed. 11) InProgress: This Payment is being processed.

SessionRequest.description: Session creation request including payment mode, version, and customization options.

version.description: Required. Plugin version. Always use the latest
version.title: Version

endpointUrl.description: Endpoint url of the plugin. Just provide the base url. For example: https://pay.travelpay.com.au
endpointUrl.title: Endpoint URL

merchantCode.description: Merchant code. Make sure the merchant code is related to the API credentials
merchantCode.title: Merchant Code

isJsPlugin.description: Is JS Plugin. Default is true. Set to false if you want to use without iframe.
isJsPlugin.title: Is JS Plugin

mode.description: Optional. Must be one of the following three values 0 - Make Payment 1 - Tokenise 2 - Custom Payment 3 - Preauthorization. Defaults to 0 if not provided.
mode.title: Mode

userMode.description: Optional. Must be one of the following two values 0 - Customer Facing - default (cardholder must enter CCV or 3DS) 1 - Merchant Facing(for merchant use only - no CCV or 3DS) - if supported by merchant options.
userMode.title: User Mode

displayMode.description: Optional. Must be one of the following two values 0 - Default(Modal) 1 - Redirect Url. Defaults to 0 if not provided. *Google Pay and Apple Pay works if Modal or Redirect Url with iframe is used.
displayMode.title: Display Mode

redirectUrl.description: Required. The page will redirect to this URL with the result in the query string. Refer the return parameters section below.
redirectUrl.title: Redirect URL

redirectOnError.description: All errors/exceptions will be return back the caller using the redirect url.
redirectOnError.title: Redirect On Error

customerName.description: Conditional. Required if mode is set to 0 or 2.
customerName.title: Customer Name

customerReference.description: Conditional. Required if mode is set to 0 or 2.
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

paymentAmount.description: Conditional. Required if mode is set to 0 or 2. Returns applicable fee if provided with mode 1.
paymentAmount.title: Payment Amount

showFeeOnTokenising.description: Required if mode is set to 1. Show the applicable fees for the token at the end of the process.Default is false.
showFeeOnTokenising.title: Show Fee On Tokenising

showFailedPaymentFeeOnTokenising.description: Optional if mode is set to 1. Show the applicable failed payment fees for the token at the end of the process.Default is false.
showFailedPaymentFeeOnTokenising.title: Show Failed Payment Fee On Tokenising

merchantUniquePaymentId.description: Required. Payment id provided by the merchant. Must be unique and can not be reused if a transaction is processed using this id. This field also work as IdempotencyKey for request for successful requests.
merchantUniquePaymentId.title: Merchant Unique Payment Id

timestamp.description: Required. Timestamp is required from v4. Provide current datetime in UTC ISO 8601 format as timestamp. format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss
timestamp.title: Timestamp

paymentAccountProxy.description: Conditional. Use this parameter to make a payment using a payment account proxy which is generated using mode '1'.
paymentAccountProxy.title: Payment Account Proxy

callbackUrl.description: Optional. The URL will be called with HTTP POST method to submit the result. Refer to Payment Plugin documentation for payment response payload.
callbackUrl.title: Callback URL

hideTermsAndConditions.description: Optional. This will hide the Terms and Conditions. Defaults to 'false' if not provided.
hideTermsAndConditions.title: Hide Terms And Conditions

sendConfirmationEmailToMerchant.description: Optional. This will send confirmation email to merchant. Defaults to 'false' if not provided.
sendConfirmationEmailToMerchant.title: Send Confirmation Email To Merchant

customerEmail.description: Required. Email address to which invoice will be emailed if the merchant is configured. It is mandatory from V4.
customerEmail.title: Customer Email

businessNumber.description: Optional. Business Number (For example: ABN). Used for reward programs if the Program is enabled to provide reward points.
businessNumber.title: Business Number

overrideFeePayer.description: Optional. Must be one of the following three values 0 - Default(based on pricing profile) 1 - Merchant(Merchant will pay the fee regardless of pricing profile setting) 2 - Customer(Customer will pay the fee regardless of pricing profile setting) Defaults to 0 if not provided.
overrideFeePayer.title: Override Fee Payer

departureDate.description: Conditional. DepartureDate is required for Slice Pay. Provide date in UTC ISO 8601 format as departureDate. format: yyyy-MM-dd
departureDate.title: Departure Date

sendConfirmationEmailToCustomer.description: Optional. This will send confirmation email to customer. Defaults to 'false' if not provided.
sendConfirmationEmailToCustomer.title: Send Confirmation Email To Customer

allowSaveCardUserOption.description: Optional. This will allow to save the card information. Defaults to 'false' if not provided. This option will only work if 'Enable Plugin Pay & Save Card' option is enabled at program or merchant level.
allowSaveCardUserOption.title: Allow Save Card User Option

sku1.description: Optional. Stock Keeping Unit - Optional text fields, allowing up to 50 alphanumeric characters. If the value exceeds 50 characters, only the first 50 characters will be retained and the rest discarded.
sku1.title: SKU 1

sku2.description: Optional Stock Keeping Unit - Optional text fields, allowing up to 50 alphanumeric characters. If the value exceeds 50 characters, only the first 50 characters will be retained and the rest discarded.
sku2.title: SKU 2

customization.description: Optional. Fields to customize the plugin fields
customization.title: Customization

fingerprint.description: Not required. This is a internal field and no need to populate.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

apiKey.description: Not required. This is a internal field and no need to populate.
apiKey.title: API Key
